pages.name: Vienna: 3.Bc4 Bc5 4.d3 d6
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the c3-knight via e2 to g3, unconfirmed; plan 2's ...a6 explained wrongly. Rewrote plans 1 (Nge2 to keep the f-pawn free) and 2 (...a6 keeps a7 for the bishop against Na4, ...Be6); British spelling in overview and plan 4.

pages.name: Vienna: 3.Bc4 Bc5 4.d3 d6 5.f4
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a Rf1-f3-g3 lift with the rook on h1 and ignored that the c5-bishop covers g1, so White cannot castle. Rewrote plan 1 (Na4 or Be3 first); British spelling in plans 2-4.

pages.name: Vienna: Smyslov, 3...Bc5 4.Bg2 Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a bare d4 with the pawn on d3. Rewrote as d3-d4; British spelling in overview.

pages.name: Vienna: Smyslov, 3...Bc5 4.Bg2 Nc6 5.Nge2
pages.notes: Plan 2 had the c3-knight going to d1 with the queen there. Rewrote it (Na4 against the c5-bishop, d3-d4 for the g2-bishop); British spelling and O-O in overview and plans 1 and 3.

pages.name: Vienna: Smyslov, 3...Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 3 sent the b1-knight to g3 though it stands on c3. Rewrote it (Nge2, castling, f2-f4 later); British spelling in overview and plans 1-2.

pages.name: Vienna Game: Frankenstein-Dracula Variation
pages.notes: Overview called 4.Bxf7+ a bishop sacrifice that permanently exposes the king; after 4...Kxf7 5.Nxe4 material is level and Black is comfortable. Rewrote overview and both plans (plan 2 had ...Kg8 with the king on e8).

pages.name: Vienna: Frankenstein-Dracula Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had ...b5 (the line is ...b6 and ...Bb7); plan 2 had Be2 with no bishop able to reach it and, in the first rewrite, an extra pawn that isn't there (reviewer). Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: Vienna: 3.Bc4 Nc6 4.d3 Bb4 5.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 1 has Ne2-g3 with the c3-knight pinned. Rewrite rejected twice (reviewer could not confirm the order of castling and a3/Bd2 against the pin); old text kept with British spelling, added to skips. Plan 2 spelling fixed.

pages.name: Vienna: 3.Bc4 Nc6 4.d3 Bc5 5.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 2 suggested Bxf6 and pressure on e5; the reviewer found that the natural follow-up Bxf6 Qxf6 Nd5 allows Qxf2 mate. Rewrote plan 2 to warn of it (cover f2 with Nf3 or Qd2 first); plan 3 reworded; British spelling in plan 1.

pages.name: Vienna: 3.Bc4 Nc6 4.d3 Bc5 5.f4
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a Rf1-f3-g3 lift and castling while the c5-bishop covers g1. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plans 3-4.
